name: Wallis Parrish
description: A pirate captain and mind-mage of the former Deadeye Fleet of the Brazen Coalition on Ixalan, who presumably later led the Bluecoats.

timeline.summary: Parrish commands the Tide Turner and secures the conditional loyalty of other Deadeye captains.
timeline.quote: Captain Wallis Parrish commanded the Tide Turner

timeline.summary: Parrish keeps the captains loyal by controlling information and handing out tips, in exchange for a share of spoils.
timeline.quote: Captain Parrish kept the other captains loyal to her by controlling the flow of information
